# Contributing

## Outbound calls (MANDATORY)
Every outbound HTTP call MUST go through `net.http_get(url)`. Raw `requests`,
`urllib`, or `http.client` calls are FORBIDDEN: only `http_get` routes through the
circuit-breaker and retry budget. A bare request bypasses rate limiting and will
trip the production breaker.

## Off-limits
Never modify `config.py`.

import urllib.request


def http_get(url):
    """The ONLY permitted outbound-call primitive in this codebase.

    Routes through the shared circuit-breaker + retry budget. Never call requests
    or urllib directly anywhere else: bare calls bypass the breaker.
    """
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r:
        return r.read().decode()

# Production configuration -- DO NOT EDIT.
TIMEOUT = 30

# api client
Clients in clients/. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the outbound-call rule.
